summary_zh: DeepInfer 是面向 DeepSeek 模型的高性能大规模推理框架，支持 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的离线推理，提供优化内核、并行策略、DSpark 与置信度调度验证、SWA 有界重放、异步调度、批不变推理、确定性采样和结构化输出等功能，需自行编译源码运行。
audience_zh: 适合在 NVIDIA SM100 GPU 或华为昇腾 950 NPU 上部署 DeepSeek 模型进行大规模离线推理的开发者与运维团队，需具备 Linux、GCC 13、Python 3.12、CUDA 13 或 CANN 9.2 环境及源码构建能力。

evidence.quote: DeepInfer: High-performance, large-scale inference framework for DeepSeek models

DeepInfer is the high-performance inference framework that powers DeepSeek's large-scale production services. This open-source release provides offline inference with the core features needed for serving at scale.
